title: Prospective Study To Assess The Outcomes Of Nitrous Oxide Cryoablation For Treatment Of Duodenal Adenomas In Patients With Hereditary Conditions Such As FAP, HNPCC
official: Prospective Study To Assess The Outcomes Of Nitrous Oxide Cryoablation For Treatment Of Duodenal Adenomas In Patients With Hereditary Conditions Such As FAP, HNPCC
summary: To learn how well nitrous oxide cryoballoon ablation, a procedure that uses extreme cold to destroy abnormal tissue, works in treating flat duodenal adenomas (abnormal growths in the small intestine) in people with FAP or Lynch syndrome (HNPCC).
criteria:
Eligibility Criteria

* Participants aged 20-75 years.
* Confirmed diagnosis of FAP or HNPCC.
* Presence of flat duodenal adenomas confirmed by histology.
* Ability to understand and willingness to sign an informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria

* Presence of invasive duodenal cancer.
* Severe comorbidities that would contraindicate endoscopic procedures.
* Allergy or intolerance to components of the nitrous oxide cryoballoon system.
* Previous duodenal surgery affecting the study area.
* Active gastrointestinal bleeding. Pregnancy
